title: Claude Code — Cost & Effectiveness

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM traces ORDER BY environment

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT provided_model_name FROM observations WHERE type='GENERATION' AND provided_model_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY provided_model_name

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM traces WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY user_id

options.content:
## Claude Code — Cost & Effectiveness

**Audience:** FinOps · Leadership · Eng Manager · **Source:** Langfuse → ClickHouse · **Refresh:** 5m

> **Data quality caveat:** observations whose model id is `claude-opus-4-7[1m]` or `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` lack token / cost values because Langfuse model-pricing config is missing. Currently ~65% of generations are affected. Configure pricing in Langfuse → Settings → Models to backfill.

panels.title: Total Cost
panels.description: Total LLM cost in selected time range

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(sum(effective_cost)) AS cost FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

panels.title: Δ vs Prior
panels.description: Cost change vs previous equal-length period

targets.rawSql: WITH (toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime)) AS span SELECT toFloat64(sumIf(effective_cost, start_time >= $__fromTime AND start_time <= $__toTime)) AS curr, toFloat64(sumIf(effective_cost, start_time >= ($__fromTime - toIntervalSecond(span)) AND start_time < $__fromTime)) AS prev, if(prev = 0, 0.0, (curr - prev) / prev * 100) AS diff_pct FROM observations_eff WHERE start_time >= ($__fromTime - toIntervalSecond(span)) AND start_time <= $__toTime AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

panels.title: Accept Rate
panels.description: Tool decisions: accept / (accept + reject)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept'))) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') + JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject'))), 0) AS accept_rate FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND (JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') + JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')) > 0

panels.title: Cache Hit %
panels.description: Cache hit rate in window: sum(cache_read) / sum(cache_read + cache_create + input)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(sum(eff_cache_read)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(eff_cache_read + eff_cache_creation + eff_input)), 0) AS hit_rate FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

panels.title: EOM Forecast
panels.description: Projected EOM total cost at the current burn rate. Turns red above $500 ($monthly_budget).

targets.rawSql: WITH toStartOfMonth(now()) AS m_start, greatest(1, toInt32(dateDiff('day', m_start, now())) + 1) AS days_so_far, toInt32(toDayOfMonth(addDays(toStartOfMonth(addMonths(now(), 1)), -1))) AS days_in_month SELECT (toFloat64(sumIf(effective_cost, start_time >= m_start)) / days_so_far) * days_in_month AS forecast FROM observations_eff WHERE start_time >= m_start AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

panels.title: Cost by Model
panels.description: Stacked cost timeseries, by model

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model, toFloat64(sum(effective_cost)) AS cost FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top Users by Cost
panels.description: Top 10 users with cost, sessions, commits

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.user_id AS user, toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS cost, count(DISTINCT t.session_id) AS sessions, sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['commit_count'])) AS commits, sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['pr_count'])) AS prs FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%' AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Repos by Cost
panels.description: From `repo:*` tags

targets.rawSql: SELECT replaceOne(arrayJoin(t.tags), 'repo:', '') AS repo, toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS cost, count(DISTINCT t.id) AS prompts FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%' AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) AND startsWith(arrayJoin(t.tags), 'repo:') GROUP BY repo ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: API Requests by Model
panels.description: Count of LLM calls per model — shows all models regardless of Langfuse pricing config. Use this until claude-opus-4-7[1m] and haiku pricing are configured.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model, count() AS requests FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

panels.title: Model Summary (all models)
panels.description: cost/tokens show NULL for models not configured in Langfuse pricing. Request count always accurate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model, count() AS requests, toFloat64(sum(effective_cost)) AS cost, toFloat64(avg((eff_input + eff_output + eff_cache_read + eff_cache_creation))) AS avg_tokens, if(countIf(effective_cost IS NOT NULL) > 0, 'OK', 'MISSING') AS pricing_ok FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY model ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.title: Tokens by Type
panels.description: Stacked: input / output / cache_read / cache_creation

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, sum(eff_input) AS input, sum(eff_output) AS output, sum(eff_cache_read) AS cache_read, sum(eff_cache_creation) AS cache_creation FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate (Trend)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, toFloat64(sum(eff_cache_read)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(eff_cache_read + eff_cache_creation + eff_input)), 0) AS hit_rate FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Cache hit rate trend: cache_read / (cache_read + cache_creation + input). Higher = better; healthy range 30-70%, depends on workload repetition.

panels.title: Cost / 1K Tokens (by Model)
panels.description: Lower = cheaper unit economics

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model, toFloat64(sum(effective_cost)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum((eff_input + eff_output + eff_cache_read + eff_cache_creation))) / 1000, 0) AS cost_per_1k FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) AND (eff_input + eff_output + eff_cache_read + eff_cache_creation) > 0 GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost_per_1k DESC

panels.title: Model Mix (token share)
panels.description: Watch Opus % drop = downgrade strategy working

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model, toFloat64(sum((eff_input + eff_output + eff_cache_read + eff_cache_creation))) AS tokens FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

panels.title: Output / Input Token Ratio
panels.description: Spike = users requesting large outputs (potential abuse)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, toFloat64(sum(eff_output)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(eff_input)), 0) AS ratio FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tokens per Session
panels.description: Total tokens per session

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(sum((o.eff_input + o.eff_output + o.eff_cache_read + o.eff_cache_creation))) AS session_tokens FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%' AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) AND t.session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.session_id HAVING session_tokens > 0

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate by Model

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model, toFloat64(sum(eff_cache_read)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(eff_cache_read + eff_cache_creation + eff_input)), 0) * 100 AS cache_hit_pct FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY model ORDER BY cache_hit_pct DESC

panels.description: Cache hit rate per model. Newer Sonnet/Opus models cache better; outliers may indicate prompt-cache misconfiguration.

panels.title: Waste Detection — challenges the ROI story
% Sessions with Cost but No Output
panels.description: Share of sessions that incurred cost but produced no commit/PR/accept. Note: thinking, reading and debugging contribute here too — not all of it is waste. Above 50%, drill into the 'No-Output Sessions' table.

targets.rawSql:
WITH session_data AS (SELECT t.session_id, sum(o.effective_cost) AS cost, sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['commit_count'])) AS commits, sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['pr_count'])) AS prs, sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts FROM traces t LEFT JOIN observations_eff o ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND t.session_id IS NOT NULL AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'
GROUP BY t.session_id) SELECT toFloat64(countIf(cost > 0 AND commits = 0 AND prs = 0 AND accepts = 0)) / nullIf(toFloat64(countIf(cost > 0)), 0) * 100 AS pct FROM session_data

panels.title: Tool Error Rate
panels.description: tool_error_count / tool_count

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(sum(toInt64OrZero(metadata['tool_error_count']))) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(toInt64OrZero(metadata['tool_count']))), 0) AS err_rate FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)

panels.title: Sessions > Alert Threshold
panels.description: Sessions whose cost exceeded $session_alert_threshold (default $5). Adjustable from the top variable.

targets.rawSql: WITH session_cost AS (SELECT t.session_id, sum(o.effective_cost) AS c FROM traces t INNER JOIN observations_eff o ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%' AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY t.session_id) SELECT countIf(c > toFloat64($session_alert_threshold)) AS above FROM session_cost

panels.title: Accept Rate Trend
panels.description: Drop = waste rising

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept'))) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') + JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject'))), 0) AS accept_rate FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND (JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') + JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')) > 0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: No-Output Sessions (cost > 0, no commits/PRs/accepts)
panels.description: These directly challenge the ROI story

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.session_id, any(t.user_id) AS user, toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS cost, count(DISTINCT t.id) AS prompts, max(t.timestamp) AS last_seen FROM traces t LEFT JOIN observations_eff o ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND t.session_id IS NOT NULL
  AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY t.session_id HAVING cost > 0 AND sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['commit_count'])) = 0 AND sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['pr_count'])) = 0 AND sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) = 0 ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top Expensive Sessions
panels.description: user, cost, duration, productive output (commits, accepts)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.session_id, any(t.user_id) AS user, toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS cost, dateDiff('minute', min(o.start_time), max(coalesce(o.end_time, o.start_time))) AS duration_min, sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['commit_count'])) AS commits, sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts FROM traces t INNER JOIN observations_eff o ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%' AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) AND t.session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.session_id ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Cost / PR

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['pr_count']))), 0) AS cost_per_pr FROM traces t LEFT JOIN observations_eff o ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

panels.description: Cost / PR: shows '—' when denominator is 0

panels.title: Cost / Commit

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['commit_count']))), 0) AS cost_per_commit FROM traces t LEFT JOIN observations_eff o ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

panels.description: Cost / Commit: shows '—' when denominator is 0

panels.title: Cost / Edit

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept'))), 0) AS cost_per_edit FROM traces t LEFT JOIN observations_eff o ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

panels.description: Cost / Accepted Edit: shows '—' when denominator is 0

panels.title: Accept / (Accept+Reject)
panels.description: Accept ratio: accept / (accept + reject). 'pending' excluded — counts only decided tool calls. Aligned with the 'Accept Rate' KPI and trend.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept'))) /
       nullIf(toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') +
                            JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject'))), 0) AS ratio
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND (JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') +
       JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')) > 0

panels.title: Active Users
panels.description: Distinct users who made an LLM call (type=GENERATION) in the window. Consistent definition across Ops/People.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS active_users
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION'
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

panels.title: Cost / User

targets.rawSql: WITH cost AS (SELECT sum(o.effective_cost) AS c FROM observations_eff o WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)), users AS (SELECT countDistinct(user_id) AS u FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT toFloat64((SELECT c FROM cost)) / nullIf(toFloat64((SELECT u FROM users)), 0) AS cost_per_user

panels.description: Total cost in window / distinct user count. Active = any trace this period (not just billable).

panels.title: Accept Rate by Model
panels.description: Which model lands suggestions most reliably

targets.rawSql: WITH tm AS ( SELECT o.trace_id, any(o.provided_model_name) AS model, any(t.metadata['tool_decisions']) AS td FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) AND t.metadata['tool_decisions'] != '' GROUP BY o.trace_id)SELECT model, toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(td,'accept'))) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(td,'accept') + JSONExtractInt(td,'reject'))), 0) * 100 AS accept_rate_pct FROM tm GROUP BY model HAVING sum(JSONExtractInt(td,'accept') + JSONExtractInt(td,'reject')) > 0 ORDER BY accept_rate_pct DESC

panels.title: User ROI Classification
panels.description: Investigate = cost > 0, zero output · Power User = high spend + high output · Contributing = normal · Inactive

targets.rawSql:
WITH user_stats AS ( SELECT t.user_id AS user, toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS cost, sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts, sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['commit_count'])) AS commits, sum(toInt64OrZero(t.metadata['pr_count'])) AS prs, count(DISTINCT t.session_id) AS sessions FROM traces t LEFT JOIN observations_eff o ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'
GROUP BY user)SELECT user, cost, accepts AS accepted_edits, commits, prs, sessions, if(accepts > 0, round(cost / accepts, 3), NULL) AS cost_per_edit, multiIf( cost > 0 AND accepts + commits = 0, 'Investigate', cost > 20 AND accepts + commits > 100, 'Power User', cost > 0 AND accepts + commits > 0, 'Contributing', 'Inactive' ) AS verdict FROM user_stats ORDER BY cost DESC

panels.title: Cost per Accepted Edit
panels.description: Improving (line going down) = ROI improving

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(t.timestamp) AS time, toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept'))), 0) AS cost_per_edit FROM traces t LEFT JOIN observations_eff o ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cumulative Cost (MTD)
panels.description: Cumulative spend since the 1st of the current month. Red threshold = static $500 — adjust this in the panel JSON if your $monthly_budget differs. (Grafana cannot inline variables into threshold values.)

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, sum(daily_cost) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS cumulative FROM (SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time) AS day, sum(effective_cost) AS daily_cost FROM observations_eff WHERE start_time >= toStartOfMonth(now()) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Monthly Budget
panels.description: MTD spend vs $monthly_budget

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(sumIf(effective_cost, start_time >= toStartOfMonth(now()))) / nullIf(toFloat64($monthly_budget), 0) * 100 AS pct FROM observations_eff WHERE start_time >= toStartOfMonth(now()) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

panels.title: Days of Budget Left
panels.description: (monthly_budget - MTD_spent) / 7-day avg daily burn. Note: bursty usage skews this; first-of-month is volatile.

targets.rawSql: WITH burn AS (SELECT toFloat64(sum(effective_cost)) / 7 AS daily FROM observations_eff WHERE start_time >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)), used AS (SELECT toFloat64(sumIf(effective_cost, start_time >= toStartOfMonth(now()))) AS u FROM observations_eff WHERE start_time >= toStartOfMonth(now()) AND type='GENERATION') SELECT (toFloat64($monthly_budget) - (SELECT u FROM used)) / greatest(0.01, (SELECT daily FROM burn)) AS days_left

panels.title: Deep Dive (Users / Models / Cache / Anomalies)
panels.description: Per-user trends, model preferences, and off-hours spend patterns

panels.title: Cost Heatmap (Hour × Time)
panels.description: Cost heatmap by hour-of-day. Easier to spot peak windows than the table version.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime(toString(toDate(start_time)) || ' ' || lpad(toString(toHour(start_time)), 2, '0') || ':00:00')) AS time,
  toString(toHour(start_time)) AS hour_bucket,
  toFloat64(sum(effective_cost)) AS cost
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%')
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY toDate(start_time), hour_bucket, time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Per-User Cost: This vs Prior Period
panels.description: Is each user's spend climbing or dropping?

targets.rawSql: WITH span AS (SELECT toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime) AS s), curr AS ( SELECT t.user_id AS user, toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS cost FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE o.start_time >= $__fromTime AND o.start_time <= $__toTime AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%' AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY user ), prev AS ( SELECT t.user_id AS user, toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS cost FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE o.start_time >= ($__fromTime - toIntervalSecond((SELECT s FROM span))) AND o.start_time < $__fromTime AND o.type='GENERATION' GROUP BY user )SELECT curr.user, curr.cost AS this_period, prev.cost AS prev_period, if(prev.cost > 0, round((curr.cost - prev.cost) / prev.cost * 100, 1), NULL) AS change_pct FROM curr LEFT JOIN prev USING (user) ORDER BY this_period DESC

panels.title: Daily Active Users

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS time,
  countDistinct(user_id) AS active_users
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Distinct users with at least one trace per day. Bars show daily granularity regardless of the dashboard window.

panels.title: Avg Session Duration

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(duration_min), 1) AS avg_min FROM (SELECT session_id, dateDiff('minute', min(timestamp), max(timestamp)) AS duration_min FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session_id HAVING duration_min > 0)

panels.description: Mean session duration (min(timestamp) → max(timestamp) per session_id). Sessions <1min filtered out as touch-and-go.

panels.title: p95 Session Duration

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(duration_min), 1) AS p95_min FROM (SELECT session_id, dateDiff('minute', min(timestamp), max(timestamp)) AS duration_min FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session_id HAVING duration_min > 0)

panels.description: p95 session duration. >3h sessions are unusual; check whether long sessions are debugging loops or unbroken work blocks.

panels.title: Most Expensive Individual API Calls
panels.description: Top 20 single LLM calls by cost. Click trace_id to open in Langfuse. Diagnose: huge context? no caching? long output?

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.user_id AS user, o.provided_model_name AS model, toFloat64(o.effective_cost) AS cost, (o.eff_input + o.eff_output + o.eff_cache_read + o.eff_cache_creation) AS tokens, o.eff_input AS input_tok, o.eff_output AS output_tok, o.eff_cache_read AS cache_read, o.trace_id, o.start_time AS time FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%' AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) AND o.effective_cost IS NOT NULL AND o.effective_cost > 0 ORDER BY o.effective_cost DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Cost Share by Model

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model, toFloat64(sum(effective_cost)) AS cost FROM observations_eff WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%') AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost DESC

panels.description: Total cost share per model in the window. Pie chart for budget conversations; for trends use 'Cost by Model'.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
 $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
 toFloat64(sum(eff_cache_read) * 2.70 / 1000000) AS cache_savings_usd
FROM observations_eff 
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
 AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%')
 AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
 AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cache Savings (USD)
panels.description: USD savings from prompt caching, computed as cache_read_tokens × $2.70/1M (Sonnet input $3.00 minus cache-read $0.30 per 1M). For mixed-model usage this is approximate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
 coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model,
 round(toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(o.eff_input + o.eff_output)), 0) * 1000000, 4) AS cost_per_1m_tokens,
 round(toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept'))) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') + JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject'))), 0) * 100, 2) AS accept_rate_pct,
 count(*) AS request_count,
 round(toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)), 2) AS total_cost
FROM observations_eff o
INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
 AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'
 AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
 AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
 AND provided_model_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY model
HAVING request_count > 10
ORDER BY total_cost DESC

panels.title: Model Performance Matrix
panels.description: Cost-Quality composite performance matrix per model

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
 SELECT 
 toDate(start_time) AS day,
 toFloat64(sum(effective_cost)) AS daily_cost
 FROM observations_eff
 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
 AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%')
 AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
 AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
 GROUP BY day
)
SELECT 
 toDateTime(day) AS time,
 daily_cost,
 avg(daily_cost) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS avg_7day,
 daily_cost - avg_7day AS deviation
FROM daily
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cost Anomalies Detection
panels.description: Cost anomaly detection: daily cost vs 7-day rolling average

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
 coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model,
 round(avg(eff_input), 0) AS avg_input_tokens,
 round(quantile(0.5)(eff_input), 0) AS median_input_tokens,
 round(quantile(0.95)(eff_input), 0) AS p95_input_tokens,
 round(max(eff_input), 0) AS max_input_tokens,
 count(*) AS sample_count
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
 AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%')
 AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
 AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
 AND provided_model_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY avg_input_tokens DESC

WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'

panels.title: Cost vs Accept Rate (Models Scatter)
panels.description: X=total cost, Y=accept rate. Top-right=high cost + high quality; top-left=low cost + high quality (ideal); bottom-right=high cost + low quality (waste).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(o.provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model,
  toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS total_cost,
  toFloat64(round(sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) * 100.0 /
                  nullIf(sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') +
                             JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')), 0), 2)) AS accept_rate
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'
  AND o.provided_model_name IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY model
HAVING total_cost > 0
ORDER BY total_cost DESC

panels.title: Output ROI Snapshot
panels.description: Composite output metric. weighted_output = commits + prs×5 + accepts×0.1

targets.rawSql:
WITH cost_data AS (
  SELECT toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS total_cost
  FROM observations_eff o
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%')
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
),
output_data AS (
  SELECT
    sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['commit_count'])) AS commits,
    sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['pr_count'])) AS prs,
    sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts
  FROM traces
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT total_cost FROM cost_data) AS spent,
  (SELECT commits FROM output_data) AS commits,
  (SELECT prs FROM output_data) AS prs,
  (SELECT accepts FROM output_data) AS accepts,
  round((SELECT total_cost FROM cost_data) / nullIf(
    (SELECT commits FROM output_data) +
    (SELECT prs FROM output_data) * 5 +
    (SELECT accepts FROM output_data) * 0.1, 0), 4) AS cost_per_weighted_output

panels.title: Hourly Cost Burn Rate (real-time)
panels.description: Hourly cost + 24-hour rolling average. Spikes = anomaly events.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  toFloat64(sum(effective_cost)) AS hourly_cost,
  avg(toFloat64(sum(effective_cost))) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 23 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_24h_avg
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%')
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

description: Cost & Effectiveness — FinOps / Leadership / Eng-Manager view. Tracks spend, ROI, budget burn, waste detection. Source: Langfuse ClickHouse · Default: last 7d, 1m refresh.
